violations.text: Raw animal foods shrimp were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods peppers in the walk-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Proper food storage reviewed with PIC. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/26/2026

Beef, egg rolls, chicken, wings, and rice were observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. New Violation. Correct By: 08/26/2026
Sauces were observed being held past the date of disposition. Sauces were voluntarily disposed of at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/26/2026
Sauces, dry ingredients, and produce was observed stored on the floor in the walk-in cooler and kitchen. Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. New Violation. Correct By: 08/26/2026

Bowls are being used as scoops in containers of dry ingredients. Utensils used to dispense non-time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods such as sugar and flour must be stored in the food item with their handles above the top of the food within the container. New Violation. Correct By: 08/26/2026
Establishment is lacking proper drain plugs for the 3-bay sink. Establishment is to obtain drain plugs. New Violation. Correct By: 08/27/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the speed rack, cook line, and outside of prep unit have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Non-food contact surfaces must be cleaned to sight and touch. New Violation. Correct By: 08/26/2026

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed at the bottom of kitchen prep table. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. PIC instructed to remove equipment that will not be used. New Violation. Correct By: 08/26/2026

An open employees' beverage container was observed stored in a food preparation area. Employees shall not drink from open beverage containers in order to prevent contamination of their hands, the container, and exposed food. -PIC relocated open beverage container. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 03/06/2025
Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (food processor) observed with food residue. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. New Violation. Correct By: 03/06/2025

Thermometers are lacking in the prep station and walk-in cooler. Cold holding equipment used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods must have at least one thermometer that is located to allow easy viewing of the temperature display. New Violation. Correct By: 03/13/2025

The door to the outside, located in the back area of kitchen, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 03/20/2025

Observed single use containers that once held sesame oil were cut up and used as scoops for food. - Proper single use articles reviewed. -The safety and quality of food can be adversely affected through single service and single use articles that are not constructed of acceptable materials. The migration of components of those materials to food they contact could result in chemical contamination and illness to the consumer. In addition, the use of unacceptable materials could adversely affect the quality of the food because of odors, tastes, and colors transferred to the food. -PIC removed containers. New Violation. Correct By: 03/06/2025

Observed 3-bay sink being used as a prep sink. The prep sink was observed being used for storage (not in use). The 3 bay sink observed with an air break. Since 3 bay sink is being used for food prep, there must be an air gap. A direct connection must not exist between the sewage system and a drain originating from equipment in which food is placed. New Violation. Correct By: 04/07/2025
